interpretive_core: Microscope preparations became durable knowledge objects through address systems: numbered slots, labels, catalogues, cabinets, registers, publication references, coordinates and later museum identifiers. These systems could preserve, translate or repair identity across replacement, remounting, dispersal and institutional recataloguing.
stop_rule: No further broad public-web, geographic or collection-count sweep. Resume research only from an exact source arrival, a user-supplied object/image, or a newly bounded identifier capable of changing attribution, chronology, object identity, custody or mechanism. Default next phase is synthesis and writing.

cleanup_policy.reason: Versioned analytical files remain part of the audit trail. Current authority is established by this manifest and the closure-saturation router, not by deleting earlier states.
